scope: two physical memory lanes on the single configured RV64 hart

instrumentation_boundary.dut_feedback_definition: no feedback into architectural next-state, ready-valid credit, lookup, retry, queue-update, or terminal action selectors
instrumentation_boundary.observer_cone: under CONFIG_NPC_OOO_STATS the current-head source enters the existing combinational SQ query observer cone; focused assertions and lint prove that its result remains action-quiet and loop-free
instrumentation_boundary.synthesis_scope: stats-conditional instrumentation; CONFIG_NPC_OOO_STATS off makes the probe constant zero so it can be optimized away; this qualification slice does not perform synthesis, STA, or PPA qualification

event_mask.lane_order: the low bit of every pair is lane0 and the high bit is lane1

fields.name: prequal
fields.meaning: bridge S_IDLE admission of a direct final-PA cached current-MIQ-head load probe

fields.name: exact
fields.meaning: prequal and the corresponding backend full mem*_sq_query_exact_w fact

fields.name: allow
fields.meaning: exact and the three-bit decision is strictly 001 in {replay,forward,allow} order

fields.name: forward
fields.meaning: exact and the three-bit decision is strictly 010 in {replay,forward,allow} order

fields.name: replay
fields.meaning: exact and the three-bit decision is strictly 100 in {replay,forward,allow} order

fields.name: invalid
fields.meaning: exact but the three-bit decision is not one of the three strict known one-hot encodings

fields.name: allow_rob_head
fields.meaning: allow, ROB head valid, ROB launch open, and current MIQ full ProducerId exactly equals the full ROB-head ProducerId

event_mask.host_decode: popcount each two-bit pair; pair 11 contributes two, never one

prequal_source.semantic_boundary: same-cycle bridge admission for the current MIQ head

lane_classification.invalid: exact && decision is not strictly one of 001,010,100
lane_classification.allow_rob_head: allow && rob_head_valid && rob_head_launch_open && known(current_miq_full_producer_id) && known(rob_head_full_producer_id) && current_miq_full_producer_id === rob_head_full_producer_id
lane_classification.x_safety: NpcSimTop converts every emitted bit to a known two-state value with case equality and exact three-bit comparisons
lane_classification.inexact_fail_closed_replay: not replay; it contributes to prequal-exact identity_or_lq_reject

host_counters.arithmetic: all cumulative additions, snapshot subtractions, derived subtraction, and conservation sums are uint64 checked
sticky_integrity: reserved or structurally impossible event encoding

region_sampling.start_snapshot: inclusive cumulative snapshot after callback for start-boundary cycle S
region_sampling.end_snapshot: inclusive cumulative snapshot after callback for end-boundary cycle E
region_sampling.delta: checked end snapshot minus start snapshot
region_sampling.containment: every region counter, including cycles and the derived reject, is no greater than its whole-run final counterpart

markers.integer_domain: all fields except schema are unsigned decimal uint64; boolean fields are restricted to 0 or 1

interpretation_boundary.prequal_is_not: StoreQueue empty residency or an SQ drain-idle cycle count
interpretation_boundary.reject_is: a bridge-admitted current-head candidate rejected by backend full identity and/or LQ openness
interpretation_boundary.allow_rob_head_is: the allow subset whose current MIQ full ProducerId is the open ROB-head ProducerId
interpretation_boundary.forbidden_inference: these event counts alone do not prove CPI, timing, area, power, or functional equivalence of an idle-fusion RTL change
